heard: The Arameans saw they had been defeated They regrouped in the shadow of the field Haddezer sent out his messengers To pull the soldiers from beyond the river They came to help him in a heavy line But Schubert leading them, commander of the fight When David was told of this new threat He gathered all Israel strong and set Crossed the Jordan to meet them face to face The Arameans drew up their lines and fled Shawbat fell where the battle raged Struck down by the hand of David's might He died there in the dust and the blood
